 Live .  24,833 viewing 24833 viewing Dawson takes superb catch to remove Marsh as Australia chase 188
 Sat 21 Nov 2026 , Men's International Twenty20 Match - 1st T20I Australia (batting) vs England, in play Australia Australia In Play England England 119 -3 ( 13.3 ) 187 -9 ( 20.0 ) Australia need 69 runs to win from 6.3 overs with 7 wickets remaining Australia innings: 119 for 3 from 13.3 overs, in play
 England innings: 187 for 9 from 20.0 overs
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scorecard 
 Summary
 First of five T20s, Melbourne
 Australia need 188 to win
 England hit record T20 international total at MCG
 Eng 187-9 (20 overs): Brook 65 (28), Banton 39 (22)
 Listen to live BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra commentary at the top of this page
 Close form Have your say on England men this winter
 Get involved Live Reporting
 by Timothy Abraham
 Post published at 11:01 GMT 11:01 GMT 
 Henry Moeran 
Commentator on BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra 
 A fabulous shot. Liam Dawson couldn't get round. We're in for a good finish.
 1 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 116-3 published at 13 overs 13 overs 
 Tim David, gold chain round his neck glistening, looks to come down the pitch to Jamie Overton but he has to settle for a single.
 Next ball a short delivery from Overton and Nikhil Chaudhary practically closes his eyes, swings his bat, and hopes.
 He gets the luck and, almost one-handed, sends it flying down past fine leg for six.
 0 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How's stat?! published at 10:59 GMT 10:59 GMT 
 Australia have ran nine 2s and two 3s with eight overs remaining in the innings.
 England managed 11 2s and no 3s during their innings.
 14 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 105-3 published at 12 overs 12 overs 
 Tim David the new batter.
 England will hope for a couple of wickets to pile the pressure back on the hosts.
 59 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 103-3 published at 11.4 overs 11.4 overs 
 Half a chance!
 Nikhil Chaudhary goes inside out to Adil Rashid again...albeit off the back foot this time.
 The ball hangs in the air but Tom Banton is not quite in range despite a diving attempt which leaves him clutching his shoulder in pain afterwards.
 10 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How's stat?! published at 10:53 GMT 10:53 GMT 
 England catch success of 84% is the highest for any side in T20 Internationals since the start of the World Cup earlier this year.
 106 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:52 GMT 10:52 GMT 
 Darren Lehmann 
Ex-Australia coach on Test Match Special 
 That's a pearler of a catch! Liam Dawson didn't have much time to react.
 It's a big wicket - Mitch Marsh the captain was just starting to get going.
 123 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 WICKET published at 11 overs 11 overs 
 Marsh c Dawson b Curran 37 (Aus 95-3) 
 What was that about England holding their catches? 
 Brilliant from Liam Dawson...
 It's too short from Sam Curran and Mitch Marsh biffs him round the corner but Dawson somehow reacts in time, taking a speccy diving to his left.
 539 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 91-2 published at 10.3 overs 10.3 overs 
 Sam Curran manages to get a bit of nip off the pitch leaving Nikhil Chaudhary driving down the wrong line.
 A couple of deliveries later and Curran's 'moon ball' is pumped back over the left-arm seamer's head for four by Mitch Marsh.
 England will be hoping for some big mishits on a big ground and, unlike Australia, they can hold their catches.
 50 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 86-2 published at 10 overs 10 overs 
 Adil Rashid with a crafty use of of pace but Nikhil Chaudhary goes inside out again and manages to plink it for a couple.
 Australia at the halfway point in their innings and England will be fairly happy you would think.
 38 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 10:45 GMT 10:45 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page 
 England getting bogged down bowling to Mitch Marsh. Need someone to wade in and dig them out of this.
 Tattz 
 43 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 82-2 published at 9.3 overs 9.3 overs 
 A big heave from Mitch Marsh against Adil Rashid but he did not middle it and has to amble through for a couple.
 The Bison not quite the quickest between the wickets these days.
 Rashid comes back with a dot before Marsh slog sweeps behind square where Aneurin Donald dives to prevent a boundary.
 26 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:42 GMT 10:42 GMT 
 Jason Gillespie 
Former Australia bowler on BBC Test Match Special 
 You sense Mitch Marsh needs to see this through now. He's soaked up a lot of deliveries.
 12 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 78-2 published at 9 overs 9 overs 
 Spin from both ends as Liam Dawson but Nikhil Chaudhary has a swagger.
 He picks up back-to-back fours - the second the most impressive as Chaudhary goes inside out to hit the left-arm spinner over extra cover, on the up, for four.
 Plenty of chat out in the middle. 
 "I didn't say anything to you..." Chaudhary snaps to an England fielder from the non-striker's end after taking a single.
 4 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 66-2 published at 8 overs 8 overs 
 Just what the doctor ordered from Adil Rashid. 
 Harry Brook being the doctor in this case.
 Don't think Brook has a PHD, or is a medical doctor, though. 
 Rambling like Mark Corrigan here. Just four runs off the over.
 99 15 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 63-2 published at 7.3 overs 7.3 overs 
 Now then, Adil Rashid into the fray.
 The experienced leg-spinner did not feature at all in the recent ODI series.
 Single and two dots to start.
 78 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 How's stat?! published at 10:35 GMT 10:35 GMT 
 Pace off has been effective so far today - just 22 runs have come off the 19 balls bowled below 75 mph with three wickets falling, including that of Sam Harper.
 26 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 62-2 published at 7 overs 7 overs 
 Target 188 
 Phil Salt, sweeping down on the boundary with a mullet flapping out the back his blue England cap, with a smart stop after Mitch Marsh slog sweeps Will Jacks again.
 23 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:33 GMT 10:33 GMT 
 Matt Clinch 
BBC Test Match Special 
 Mitch Marsh is looking to go on the attack now.
 9 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Aus 57-2 published at 6.1 overs 6.1 overs 
 Will Jacks into the attack but a commanding slog sweep from Mitch Marsh sends his first delivery off to the boundary for four.
